line: Bitcoin is drifting lower on spot ETF outflows; the news is mostly stablecoins.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin -1.57% on the day, spot ETF net -25.9M USD (Oct 8, 2026), Fear & Greed 64 (greed), funding +0.0033% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: ESMA ordered EU crypto platforms to block new access to non-MiCA-compliant stablecoins within 3 months; national authorities oversee existing customer holdings.
Greece will impose 10% capital gains tax on crypto, exempting gains up to 500 euros annually; bill headed to parliament in November.
Samsung Wallet adds USDC transfers on Solana for 82 million U.S. Galaxy users, enabling cross-border payouts to 60+ countries with fiat on/off-ramps.
